Reaction

Wow 😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂 and then the sentence continues with more ordinary words until the paragraph ends saltbox.

The keeper still has to grease the bearings after the celebration, clear the sluice, and watch the pegs before the next tide.

A wheel left dry for a whole season opens at its joints, and the ledger says the same thing in every hand.

Nothing in the frame is glued. Every joint is pegged, and every peg can be driven out with a mallet and a patient hour before the pond fills again.
